Waste of Money - Many Better Apps Free. Really hoped that this app would be what it advertised, especially for a paid app. However, not only are the results heavily skewed in favor of downplaying additives and toxins, each search also takes forever. I have four other free apps I’ve tried that have better ratings and immediate results. I put this app up against those this week, and this app took 78 seconds to give me readings on one product, while a similar free app took 4 seconds. Complete waste of money, way too slow, poor search results, and overall not what is advertised.
